detail.overview: Intex SA90RDFG1 | 9 kg Semi-Automatic Washing Machine The Intex SA90RDFG1 9 kg Semi-Automatic Washing Machine is built to provide the best washing experience for your laundry needs. Featuring 3 wash programs and an anti-corrosive, rust-free body, this machine ensures durability and efficiency. Its 9 kg capacity is ideal for families, and the powerful motor with advanced water-saving technology guarantees top-notch washing performance. With its toughened glass lid, hydraulic wash lid, and magic filter, this washing machine brings a blend of convenience, efficiency, and longevity to your home.
features: Roller Jet with Mini Pulsator Design
